---
title: "Registry"
---

The registry's own documentation: what the vocabulary means, what was decided
and why, what each contract is, and the guides that record how the repository is
laid out and worked in.

## [Glossary](glossary.md) {#glossary}

`CONTEXT.md` is the authority on project vocabulary, and the site stages it at
render time as this page. Use its terms in code, configuration, documentation,
issue comments and commit messages.

## [Decisions (ADRs)](adr/0038-one-home-per-kind-of-thing.md) {#decisions}

One numbered decision per constraint on future work, from the Store Registry
boundary (0001) to the Analysis Catalog (0039) and Association Coverage in the
Release Bundle (0040). A later ADR supersedes an earlier one explicitly rather
than quietly contradicting it. The whole set is in the sidebar, or in
`docs/adr/`.

## [Specifications](spec/store-release-workflow.md) {#specifications}

The contracts the code is held to: the Release Bundle schema, the Store Release
workflow and its boundary, the QC Panel Concordance preregistration, release
configuration, and source connectors.

## Guides

The repository's layout, its runtime, the software-management proposal and
audit, and the evidence records from the MVPs and pilots. They are `docs/*.md`,
and the sidebar lists them.

## How the pages are built

Every page here comes from a file under `docs/` and keeps its path. A link from a
page to a file outside `docs/` — a module under `src/`, a table under
`resources/`, `CONTRIBUTING.md` — is rewritten at render time to the GitHub blob
URL of the commit being rendered, so it works on the site and still points at the
same file. See [the site page](site.md) for how to preview and publish.
